result.summary: I added src/test/java/org/traccar/api/resource/HealthResourceTest.java. It has 5 JUnit/Mockito tests: 200 OK when storage answers, 500 when storage throws StorageException, 500 when the stored-message ratio drops below web.healthCheck.dropThreshold, 200 when the ratio stays above the threshold, and 200 when no threshold is set. HealthResource.java is unchanged. The tests set the private @Inject fields with reflection and reset the static message counters before each test, so tests stay independent of run order. This worktree has no Makefile, AGENTS.md or docs/ (the implement-change skill comes from a sibling checkout), so `make test` and `make check-fast` could not be run. I ran the likely Gradle equivalents with JDK 25: the new class passes 5/5, and Checkstyle plus the full unit test suite pass with 617 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors and 27 skipped. I did not add or change any skips.

changes.summary: New unit test for GET /api/health: database check (OK and StorageException) and dropThreshold ratio logic (below, above, unset), using Mockito for Config, StatisticsManager and Storage.
